name: Ann Arbor District Library Volunteer Program (teens and adults)
what_you_do: Prepare materials for library programs and give occasional program support. Shelving books is done by paid staff.
who_can_apply: Anyone 14 or older. Ages 14 to 17 must get a work permit through the state Youth Employment Permit Portal. On school days they can only volunteer after 3:30 p.m.
duration: Ongoing; you commit to the shifts you sign up for
deadline_text: The page lists no open or close dates. Fill out the online form, then attend a volunteer orientation.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer application. Teens send it in along with the work permit application. After review you are contacted with details on signing up for a required volunteer orientation, then you pick shifts.
notes: Older library posts mention a summer teen volunteer program. The current page only describes the year-round program.
